rationale: The plan matches the reference: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with median-of-ratios inside the model, a minimal 10-counts-in-3-samples pre-filter plus independent filtering, explicit ~condition design with control as reference and a treated-vs-control contrast, BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage, and an explicit low-power statement at n=3 that keeps alpha unchanged. The edgeR QL replication and leave-one-out stability are optional but correctly framed (intersection, not union, as high-confidence). QC covers blind-vst PCA, sample distances, and library sizes colored by condition, but states only that an outlier verdict will be written without a policy for what happens to an outlier or shallow sample. The report step names methods, versions, design, thresholds, tested/DE counts, and design caveats, and enrichment is correctly omitted.
